latest_release.body:
## 24.1.0 (2026-11-26)

### 🚀 Features

- **angular-rspack:** add an option to serve SSR from the dev server ([#37800](https://github.com/nrwl/nx/pull/37800), [#37703](https://github.com/nrwl/nx/issues/37703))
- **core:** stop scaffolding apps and libs folders for preset generators ([#37635](https://github.com/nrwl/nx/pull/37635))
- **core:** support NX_DB_NAME for local databases ([#37200](https://github.com/nrwl/nx/pull/37200), [#37573](https://github.com/nrwl/nx/pull/37573))
- **core:** move @nx/conformance and @nx/owners into the nx repo ([#37636](https://github.com/nrwl/nx/pull/37636))
- **core:** generate a pruned bun.lock for Bun deploy outputs ([#37841](https://github.com/nrwl/nx/pull/37841))
- **core:** import compact UltraCache configurations from files ([#37968](https://github.com/nrwl/nx/pull/37968))
- **core:** detect google antigravity ai agent and filter daemon env ([#37987](https://github.com/nrwl/nx/pull/37987), [#37986](https://github.com/nrwl/nx/issues/37986))
- **core:** support GitHub Copilot CLI in agentic nx migrate ([#37959](https://github.com/nrwl/nx/pull/37959))
- **core:** hash unstable files from ultracache recordings by default ([#38056](https://github.com/nrwl/nx/pull/38056))
- **core:** expand regular filesets through the disk expansion entry model ([#37319](https://github.com/nrwl/nx/pull/37319))
- **devkit:** let convert-to-inferred choose plugin options per project ([#37768](https://github.com/nrwl/nx/pull/37768))
- **dotnet:** add evaluated MSBuild project tags ([#36677](https://github.com/nrwl/nx/pull/36677))
- **js:** remove the deprecated classproperties babel preset option ([#37634](https://github.com/nrwl/nx/pull/37634))
- **js:** report Verdaccio startup readiness ([#37683](https://github.com/nrwl/nx/pull/37683))
- **linter:** add @nx/directive-checks to lint Nx file directives ([#37725](https://github.com/nrwl/nx/pull/37725))
- **linter:** default to ESLint v10 and migrate existing workspaces ([#37774](https://github.com/nrwl/nx/pull/37774))
- **misc:** let eslint and vitest inferred targets run from the workspace root ([#37754](https://github.com/nrwl/nx/pull/37754))
- **misc:** convert eslint and vitest targets to run from the workspace root ([#37770](https://github.com/nrwl/nx/pull/37770))
- **node:** support NestJS 12 ([#36937](https://github.com/nrwl/nx/pull/36937))
- **nx-cloud:** add nx cloud ci as a ci-workflow provider ([#38041](https://github.com/nrwl/nx/pull/38041))
- **nx-dev:** validate nx.dev links in packages/ against the docs sitemap ([#37805](https://github.com/nrwl/nx/pull/37805))
- **nx-dev:** serve the ci plan cost calculator from the blog site ([#37792](https://github.com/nrwl/nx/pull/37792))
- **nx-dev:** show nx.dev site banner as top bar in docs ([#37853](https://github.com/nrwl/nx/pull/37853))
- **release:** add opt-in releaseBoundaryCheck for dependencies crossing the release boundary ([#37963](https://github.com/nrwl/nx/pull/37963))
- **vitest:** support @nx-depends-on in atomized test files ([#38051](https://github.com/nrwl/nx/pull/38051))

### 🩹 Fixes

- **angular:** register the ssr dev server afterEmit hook only once ([#37589](https://github.com/nrwl/nx/pull/37589), [#37587](https://github.com/nrwl/nx/issues/37587))
- **angular:** remove the serve-ssr target that rspack ssr apps can't run ([#37908](https://github.com/nrwl/nx/pull/37908))
- **angular:** load architect node host through its exported subpath ([#37951](https://github.com/nrwl/nx/pull/37951))
- **angular:** stop setup-ssr from losing router options or corrupting the file ([#37937](https://github.com/nrwl/nx/pull/37937))
- **angular:** don't prefix existing secondary entry point globs in tsconfig ([#38021](https://github.com/nrwl/nx/pull/38021), [#38013](https://github.com/nrwl/nx/issues/38013))
- **angular-rspack:** install the plugin after Angular dependencies ([#37562](https://github.com/nrwl/nx/pull/37562))

detail.readme:
Smart Monorepos · Fast Builds


[**Docs**](https://nx.dev/docs)  •  [**Changelog**](https://nx.dev/changelog)  •  [**Blog**](https://nx.dev/blog)  •  [**Courses**](https://nx.dev/courses)  •  [**YouTube**](https://youtube.com/@nxdevtools)
Nx is a monorepo solution for TypeScript and polyglot codebases. Built with Rust for performance, extensible via TypeScript. Caches what didn't change, runs only what's affected, and comes with an integrated CI solution. Start simple, scale as you grow. ## Quick Start Visit the [Nx quickstart docs](https://nx.dev/docs/quickstart) to get started. ## Why Nx? - **Incremental by design -** Run `npx nx init` in any npm/pnpm/yarn workspace. Nx picks up your existing `package.json` scripts, caches their outputs, and runs only what's affected. No changes to your setup required. - **AI-native tooling -** The Nx CLI is optimized for autonomous AI agents so they get the context they need and can operate just like a human. [Learn more »](https://github.com/nrwl/nx-ai-agents-config) - **Polyglot plugin system -** Optional plugins auto-discover tasks, configure cache inputs/outputs, and scaffold code based on your actual tooling. Works with Vite, Webpack, Jest, Vitest, ESLint, Gradle, Maven, .NET, Go, and [more](https://nx.dev/technologies). - **Integrated CI solution -** [Connect Nx to your CI provider](https://nx.dev/ci/intro/ci-with-nx) (GitHub Actions, GitLab, Azure, etc.) to enable remote caching, task distribution across machines, affected-only runs, and automatic e2e test splitting. [Learn more »](https://nx.dev/ci/intro/ci-with-nx) - **Self-healing CI -** An AI agent on your CI pipeline that detects failures, analyzes root cause, proposes a fix, and verifies it automatically. Local agents connect to CI via MCP to autonomously detect and fix failures. [Learn more »](https://nx.dev/ci/features/self-healing) ## Who uses Nx? From startups to Fortune 500 companies. [See our Nx success stories »](https://nx.dev/customers) ## Want to help? If you want to file a bug or submit a PR, read up on our [guidelines for contributing](https://github.com/nrwl/nx/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md). ## Core Team | Victor Savkin | Jason Jean | Benjamin
